His friend told him a mysterious legend that somewhere in the world there was a treasure, and whoever had it would gain endless riches. The rich man decided to look for this treasure. He ran here and there and spent most of his time and energy, but in the end found nothing. On a stormy night, the rich man came home and sat in his chair, exhausted. Suddenly he saw a young boy walk into the room and say to him with a smile, “The treasure is in your heart.”

This story tells us that true blessing is not outward wealth and material enjoyment, but inner peace and joy. Only when we turn our focus from worldly pursuits to our relationship with God can we truly experience blessing in this life. This blessing does not mean how perfect our circumstances are, but how close and firm our relationship with God is.

When we focus on pursuing spiritual growth, and call on Yahweh God to save us from the oppression of worldly people, we will find that true blessing is deep in our hearts. This blessing will not be shaken by outward difficulty, but can bring us faith, hope, and love.

So today, let us return to the arms of Yahweh God and wholeheartedly pursue His will and heart. Do not be deceived by worldly temptation, but believe that Yahweh has prepared eternal blessings in heaven for us.
ah: In daily life, we can put this passage into practice in the following ways:
a: Ask for the Holy Spirit’s help
Each day in prayer, ask the Holy Spirit to guide us away from the values and temptations of the world.
Share in fellowship with believers
Share life, difficulties, and victories with spiritual companions and support one another.
Read and pray
Spend time each day reading the Bible, seeking God’s word, and applying what you have learned in daily life through prayer.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding us today to be free from the values of the world and to pursue Your good will. Give us wisdom and inspiration to put today’s action guide into practice in daily life, to walk with You and receive true blessing. We pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you! May you receive true blessing as you pursue God’s will, full of faith, hope, and love. May you break free from worldly views and focus on spiritual growth, and experience every day the blessing of this life that God has given. Amen.

t: God Is My Portion
v: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
b: When we face difficulty and challenge in life, we often feel our strength draining away and our spirits weakening. Sometimes we may ask why we have to go through such suffering. Have we been abandoned? But this passage reminds us that though our flesh and our heart may fail, God is still the strength of our heart and our portion.

A young athlete was seriously injured in a competition and could no longer compete. He felt very hopeless and disappointed and thought his sports career was over. Yet he did not give up, but turned to God and sought His strength and healing.

One day he met an old man, who told him a story about a butterfly. Before it becomes a beautiful mature butterfly, it must go through a hard process of transformation. It is this process that shapes the butterfly’s beauty and strength. The young athlete was inspired by the story, and he began to believe that although he now faced difficulty, God was using these challenges to make him stronger.

The athlete began to trust God and no longer relied only on his own strength. He learned to look at difficulty with his heart and to seek God’s help and guidance. In the end the athlete found hope and confidence again. He returned to the field, showing great strength and courage, and became an example that inspired others.

This story tells us that, like this athlete, we too can find strength and blessing in life. Though we may face all kinds of difficulties and challenges, remember that God is the strength of our heart. He is beside us and will never leave us.

Let us bring this truth into our lives. When we feel helpless and weak, turn to God and rely on His strength. Let us believe that though this world brings many difficulties, God will be our portion forever.
dc:
In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you find God’s strength and blessing in every difficulty. Amen!
No. 449 Soul Snack Action Guide. Psalm 73:26: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

t: God Is My Portion
v: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
b: In this passage we see a beautiful truth, that God is our portion. Our portion does not mean the wealth, status, or outward things we possess, but our relationship with God, and having a special treasure in His grace and love.

Like a rich man who had countless wealth and possessions, yet felt empty inside. He realized that money cannot bring true happiness and satisfaction. But when he began to build a relationship with God, he found that God became his greatest portion. God’s love and grace filled his heart and gave him true joy and peace.

In our own lives we too often pursue worldly glory and pleasure. We want to have more wealth, power, and fame. Yet all of these are temporary and will not bring true satisfaction. Only in God can we find true blessing.

It is like a child who sees all kinds of toys in a toy store and may want to have them all. But when he gets home, he soon finds that those toys cannot truly bring him happiness, because happiness lies not in having more toys but in spending time with family and feeling their love and care.

In the same way, in our lives we can pursue all kinds of worldly desires and pleasures, but these will not bring true satisfaction. Only when we put God first and build an intimate relationship with Him can we truly taste the flavor of blessing.
Now let us reflect together on our own lives. Have we been looking for outward things to fill the emptiness inside? Have we overlooked the true blessing God has given?
I encourage everyone to put God at the center of life and take His word as our guide. When we learn to keep God’s word, we will find that His promises become our treasure.
ah: In daily life, we can put this passage into practice in the following ways:
a: Begin each day by praying to God with a thankful heart and reading Scripture to seek His will.
Keep God’s word in your heart, and often meditate on it and memorize Bible verses, so that God’s word becomes the guide for our lives.
When you meet challenge or difficulty, do not lose heart easily, but trust God’s promise and firmly follow His way.
Share God’s works and words with brothers and sisters, encouraging one another and growing together in faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for being our portion. Help us keep Your word every day, so that our lives are full of faith, hope, and love. Lead us to put this passage into practice in daily life, so that our lives show Your glory. We pray in the name of Jesus. Amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you: may you understand that God is your portion, and that whatever difficulty you meet in life, you can find faith, hope, and love in God’s love and grace. Amen.
